definitions.explanation: Used to ask about the price or cost of something.
In the pattern いくら〜ても, means 'no matter how much.'

examples.japanese: これは{幾|いく}らですか。
{全部|ぜんぶ}で{幾|いく}らになりますか。
examples.english: How much does it come to in total?

examples.japanese: {幾|いく}ら{食|た}べても{太|ふと}らない。
examples.english: No matter how much I eat, I don't gain weight.

examples.japanese: この{本|ほん}は{幾|いく}らでしたか。
{電車|でんしゃ}の{切符|きっぷ}は{幾|いく}らですか。
examples.english: How much is the train ticket?

examples.japanese: {幾|いく}ら{待|ま}っても{来|き}ませんでした。
examples.english: No matter how long I waited, they didn't come.

examples.japanese: {幾|いく}ら{説明|せつめい}しても{分|わ}かりません。
examples.english: No matter how much I explain, they don't understand.

examples.japanese: {一|ひと}つ{幾|いく}らですか。{三|みっ}つください。
examples.english: How much is each one? I'll take three, please.

examples.japanese: {幾|いく}ら{考|かんが}えても、いい{方法|ほうほう}が{思|おも}いつきません。
examples.english: No matter how much I think, I can't come up with a good method.

examples.japanese: この{時計|とけい}は{幾|いく}らしましたか。{高|たか}そうですね。
examples.english: How much did this watch cost? It looks expensive.

notes: {幾|いく}ら is one of the most essential question words for daily life in Japan, especially when shopping. The phrase これは{幾|いく}らですか is one of the first phrases learners should master. The word is often written in hiragana. In the いくら〜ても pattern, it expresses 'no matter how much.'
